title: Charred Cauliflower Ramen
description: A Japanese-inspired twist on traditional ramen, featuring charred cauliflower and a savory miso broth.
instructions: Cut cauliflower into florets and toss with vegetable oil, salt, and pepper. Roast for 20-25 minutes, or until charred.
In a large pot, combine miso paste, soy sauce, and water. Whisk until smooth.
Bring the miso mixture to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes.
Cook ramen noodles according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
To assemble the dish, place cooked noodles in a bowl. Add roasted cauliflower, sliced green onions, and grated ginger.
Drizzle the miso broth over the top and sprinkle with charred sesame seeds.
